item.title: Jokuh and BNB Chain Align Ahead of Consensus Miami
item.description: BNB Chain's ecosystem team has opened technical alignment with Jokuh ahead of Consensus 2026 in Miami, with Jokuh architecting natively across BSC, opBNB, and Greenfield from day one.

item.title: Jokuh at Consensus 2026
item.description: Jokuh will be at Consensus 2026 in Miami to demonstrate the Sovereign Agentic Operating System and meet investors, builders, and partners working at the intersection of AI, identity, and on-chain settlement.

item.title: Backing from Red Beard Ventures and Denarii Labs
item.description: Jokuh confirms institutional backing from Red Beard Ventures and Denarii Labs to advance the Sovereign Agentic Operating System, a private, local-first runtime for memory, identity, and agent workflows.

item.title: Spine ships to TestFlight
item.description: The encrypted personal memory layer at the core of Jokuh is now live for active TestFlight users, keys held by the user, computation verified through TEE, ZKP, and FHE.

item.title: Grants from Avalanche, RunPod, Hume AI, and Kihew
item.description: Four ecosystem grants, across settlement, compute, voice, and regional infrastructure, confirm independent technical validation of the Jokuh stack.
